project_type: Full-stack TypeScript monorepo (npm workspaces): React+Vite frontend (JA/EN i18n), AWS Lambda backend, DynamoDB, Amazon Bedrock chat, AWS CDK infra. Digimon-style monster raising game. This task is GitHub issue #19: move the conversation UI (input + send button, optionally recent transcript) so it renders visually next to the monster sprite, completing the 'talking to the monster right here' experience alongside the #11 speech bubble.
